translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Ome-metedgi, degi, sui-metedgi Jesús sunmaksad

Jesús Capernaumgi nadbargu, Judea-yalaganba nonikid, Jordán-diwar-obakar yar-naidse. Agi gudii, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad. Ar igi Jesús gusgu na dulemar-odurdak-dae, deyob dulemar-odurdakdebarsunnad.
Fariseomar Jesússe nonimarmogad, yamo Jesús-wilubdakegar. Ese egisnonimalad: —¿Wede sunna ome-metoye igar mai?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —¿Moisés igi igar bemarga mesissunna?
Fariseomar, abin-sogdemar: —Moisés sogsad, sui ome-metebiele, ome-meted-garda omega ukoye, geb degi ome-metoye.
Jesús, Fariseomar-abin imakdebargu, sogded: “Bemar-uayasur-daedbali Moisés bemarga wegi-igar mesisad.
Ar Bab Dummaddi deyob igar-mesissulid.
A-ular Bab Dummad sogsabalid:
Degisoggu, abirgunagwar Bab-Dummad-dule-imaksadi, mer na meted imakmarsun.”
A-sorba, Jesús-sapinganbi bachikii neggi bukwamargu, gannar ome-meted-igargi Jesússe egichiarmalad.
Jesús, amarga sogded: Ar doa-dule ome-mete-dibe, degi, ome-baid-nikusale, we-machered ome-dikarba neg-sichigi yolediido.
Degi, ome sui-mete-dibe, sui-baid-nikusale, a-ome sui-dikarba neg-sichigi yoledimodo.
Jesús mimmigangi nued binsasad
Jesússe mimmigan-sedani-gusmalad, Jesús ega ebugegar, adi Bab Dummad nued mimmigangi binsaegar. Jesús-sapingan dulemar-mimmigan-senonimaladse uluarmalad.

Jesús, e-sapingan dulemarse-urwenai dakargu, saebaksaar itos, e-sapinganga sogded: —Mer ese urwemar. Mimmigan be anse daged imakmar, mer be bargamar, ar Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid we-mimmiganyob-damaladgadid.
Napira an bemarga sogmalad, ar dule-wargwen Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid mimmiganyob abingasulile, geg Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse doged.
Geb degi Jesús e-argangi mimmigan-susgua, e-argan mimmigan-birgi mesisgu, nued mimmigangi binsad sogded: “Bitigi Bab Dummad nued bemargi binsaena-gadin.”
Dule-mani-ibed Jesússe nonikid
Jesús nasokargu, dule-wargwen ese abarmaknonikid, yokorgi sindigar Jesús-abin signonikid, ese egisnonikid: —Odurdaked-saila-nued, ¿ibi an imaker-gebe, burba-geg-bergued an abingaegar?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ibiga dule-nuedye be anga soge? Dule-nued-sulid, unnila Bab Dummadbi wargwennaa dule-nued gued.
Ar Bab Dummad igar-mesisad be wisid:

content.text: be-babgi, degi, be-nangi nue-binsaed-nikaa be damaloye.

content: Dule, abin-sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, gusgu an-sapingwagwad-akar bela we-igarmar-mamaidba an nanadiid.

Degi Jesús dule-dakdegu, nue-sabedba ega sogde: —Ibmar-gwensak amba be napi: Be-negse be nae, bela ibmar-be-nikad manigi be uknae, geb agi mani wileganaga be mimmioed. Geb degiir be nibneggi ibmar-nued be nikuoed. Geb a-sorba anba be dagoed, an-sapinga guegar.
Degi, dule wegi-ega-soglesadba undar-naibi-itos naded, ar ade dule-mani-ibedid.
Agi Jesús e-dikarba atakdegu, e-sapinganga sogded: —¡Ibiyobi dulemar-mani-ibganga Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse-doged igar-dutusuli, ar ade dogdar maniginbi binsamalad!

Weyob-Jesús-ibmar-sogsad, e-sapingan geger itodmalad, ar ade mani-ibgan bur-baisursunnaa abonolegoye bimalad. Degi, Jesúsdi gannar e-sapinganga sogdesunnad: —Sapingan, dule-maniginbi-dogdar-binsamaladgardi Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse-doged ega igar dutusulid.
Ar ade moli-yargan-mureged bur-baisursunnaa iko-ibyagi doged, ar dule-mani-ibeddi bur-beedse Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse doged.
Ar Jesús wegi-sogsabargu, bur-bule e-sapingan geger itodmalad, na dukin-dukin ese egisnanai-guarmalad: “¿Ar doa degite sunna abonolegosunna?”
Jesús na e-sapingan-dakdegu, ega sogded: —Ar dulemargardi geg gue, Bab Dummadgardi igar nollo maid, ar Bab Dummadgardi bela ibmar sunna guedbiid.
Degi Pedro Jesúsga sogdesun: —¿Anmardina? Anmardi belagwapa-ibmar-obesad, adi anmar beba naegar.

Jesús, Pedro abin-sogded: “Napira an bemarga soged, dule-wargwensaar an-nug-ular, degi, an-gaya-burba-nued-ular ibmar-meter, e-neg, e-gwenadgan, e-bunmar, e-bab, e-nan, e-ome, e-mimmigan, degine, e-nainu,

we-dule dulataledba bur-bule we-napneggi ibmar abingaosurdeeye soglesulid: Negmar, gwenadgan, bunmar, nangan, mimmigan, degine, nainugan, dulataledba bur-bule abingaedsegad. Ar mesagwar we-napneggi gudiguo-inigwele, ibagan-danikoedsedi burba-geg-bergued nikuoed.
“Degisoggu, dummagan-bukidar, dule-sorbamaladga guoed, degi, dule-sorbamalad, dummaganga gumogoed.”
Jesús ilapaagud gannar na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad

Jesús na e-sapingan idumai, Jerusalén-igarba nadap-gusad. E-sapingan-e-yarganba-danimalad geger dakmalad, degi, nue-dobe itomarbalid, ar ade bonigan-abarse nadapid. Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwadbi bachikii ese gochagua, amarga sogded e-guoed igargan:

“Emide anmar Jerusalénse nadapmalad, ani Dule-Machi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummaganse, degi, escribamarse uklegoed. Amar sogmaloed, oburgwemarye, geb degi Judio-dummagan Judiosurmaladga an-ukmaloed.
Geb degi Judiosurmalad angi dodomaloed, angi wiakmarbaloed, an-sarsomarbaloed, agi geb an-oburgwemaloed. A-sorba ibapaagi gannar an durguoed.”
Juan, degi, Santiago, dummadga gubigusmalad
Santiago, Juan, Zebedeo-machimala, Jesússe nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Odurdaked-saila, anmarga be ibmar ukbi anmar abedo, anmar bese ibmar egisoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ibi bemarga ukbi be an-abesunna?
Jesús-abin imakdemalad: —Yoedse bela be-ganguedgi be-ologangi be sigisale, be-sorbalidga be anmar-imake, be-dikarba anmar-sied be anmar-imake, gwensak be-argan-nuedsik, baid be-sapiledsik.

Geb Jesús amarga sogded: —Bemar amba wichulid ibi anse bemar egisnai, amba be aku-itomalad. ¿Ar nue-dummad an wilegoedgi sunna bemar wilemogosi, an nog-goboedyob? Degine, ¿an-digi-oglegoedgi sunna bemar oglemogosi? A Jesús obaris-gusad, e-wilegoed, degi, e-burgoed.
Degi Santiago, Juan-ebo, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar sunnamala. Geb Jesús amarga sogded: —Eye, nabiri, an-nog-goboed sunna bemar gobmogoed, an-digi-oglegoedgi sunna bemar a-digi oglemarmogoed.
Ar an-argan-nuedsik, degi, an-argan-sapiledsik-sigeddi an-sogedba uklegosulid, unnila bato dulemarga-uklegoye-soglesmaladga Bab Dummad ukoed.
E-sapingan-baigan-ambe-guedi, Juan, degi, Santiago, dummadga-gubimalad-egisnai-itosmargu, ese uludmalad.

Ar Jesúsdi na e-sapinganse gochagu, amarga sogded: “Bemardi nue wismalad, dulemar-we-napneg-dummaganga-gudimaladdi e-sordamarba bur dule-dummad na san imak-daed, degisoggu, bela-ega-ibmar-imakbi abe-damarsunnad. Degine, e-sorbarmalad gandikidba dulemar-barmidaed.
“Bemardi mer deyob gumalo, ar be dummadga gubiele, maiyob bela be dulemar-bendaker-gebed.
Ar be dulemar-iduedga gubiele, bela-dulemar-maiga be nanadii-guer-gebed.
“Ar ani Dule-Machi, we-napnegse an nonigu, mai-nikuega an nonisulid, maiyob dulemar-bendakega an nonikid, degine, an na san-burba-ukegar, adi dule-iskudimalad-anar an burgwegar.”
Jesús Bartimeo-aku-ataked nudaksad

Jesús na e-sapinganmala Jericóse nonimalad. Jericógi bangudbargu, e-sapingan, degi, dule-bukidar e-sorba duurmaknadap-gusmalad. Deun dule-aku-ataked, Timeo-machi, Bartimeo-nugad, igarba sii, wilesakwaa mani egissii-gusad.
Bartimeo itoargu Jesús-Nazaretgined nadapye, binnasur gote, sogded: —¡Jesús, Rey-David-Wagwa, be an-bendake, wile be an-dake!
Bukidar Bartimeose uluarmalad, boo be sigye ega sogdemalad. Aka-bur-bule Bartimeo binnasur gorsigisad: —David-Wagwa, wile be an-dake.
Degi Jesús gwisgusgu, sogded: —Ese gornamar. Geb Bartimeose gochamalad, ega sogdemalad: —Bartimeo, be gandik sae, be gwisgu, Jesús bese goled.
Geb Bartimeo e-suba mide, yog gwisguar, Jesússe nonisunnad.
Jesús Bartimeoga sogded: —¿Ibi bega imakbi be an-abege? Dule-aku-ataked, abin-sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, ibya an nugubied.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be nae, be an-bengussursoggu, be nugussun. Geb agi Bartimeo yog magasaila atakar naded, degi, Jesúsba nadap-gussunnad.
